character.motivation: Knows a verse missing from the town song. Wants permission before turning anyone else's grief into a performance.
character.voice: Attentive to rhythm. Usually ends on an image or a question.
character.backstory: Roan learned the town song with a verse about the low bank that people stopped singing after the flood. A request for a song about the hearing leaves him deciding whose words he has permission to use.
character.quest_hook: Listen to the missing verse and help Roan ask the people it describes whether they want it sung at the next gathering.

dialogue.introduction: The second verse is the one people stop singing. That's usually where the trouble is.
dialogue.friendship: A song can make somebody sound braver than they felt. I ask before I use a person's name now.
dialogue.supper: I played the second verse. Nobody sang along at first. By the last line, two people knew it.
dialogue.hearing: I've been asked for a song about the vote. I'm going to start by listening to the people who left the room.
dialogue.favorite_gift: An apple's a fair price for the second verse. Want to hear it?
dialogue.disliked_gift: Fodder in the fiddle case would keep the fiddle very quiet. I have other methods.

routine.home_context: Keeps a home near the commons route so neighbors can hear him practice before supper.
